a.name: Window card
a.description: One deep-steel card: H2 and answer left, the photo in a bone window right, then the H3 with its own photo first and a brass pill.
a.differs_from: A whole body section inside one steel card with its photo in a bone window; London's pick is two H3 chapters in a sunk tray, and the built rows are plain prose with the image right or above.

b.name: Zigzag pair
b.description: The H2 row with its photo left, the H3 row with its photo right, both in the uniform in-body box, divided by hairlines.
b.differs_from: Two open rows whose photos swap sides, framed by hairlines on the bone page; London's pick is a compact tray of chapters, and the built rows keep the image on one side or above.

c.name: Offset sheet
c.description: The photo offset on a steel-100 block bleeding off the left; right, the question, a two-by-two deposit sheet and a brass pill.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's one column of five label-and-value rows becomes a two-by-two sheet divided by a hairline cross from 640px. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
